verifications.claim: The 2026 UFL season features eight teams.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The UFL remains an eight-team league for 2026', 'The UFL will once again field eight teams'; R3: 'will once again feature a slate of eight teams'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the league has eight teams in 2026 and list them.

verifications.claim: Play in the 2026 UFL season begins on March 27, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Beginning March 27 with the Birmingham Stallions hosting the Louisville Kings'; R3: 'will begin its 2026 campaign on Friday, March 27'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the season starts on March 27, 2026.

verifications.claim: The 2026 UFL consists of five returning teams: Birmingham Stallions, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, St. Louis Battlehawks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Five of which—the Birmingham Stallions, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, St. Louis Battlehawks and Houston Gamblers—return from last season'; R1 supports with team list and non-returning teams
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly lists the exact five returning teams; R1 consistent.

verifications.claim: The 2026 UFL consists of three new franchises: Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'New UFL teams for 2026 The Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings and Orlando Storm are the three teams set to compete in their inaugural UFL seasons in 2026'; R3: 'three—the Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings and Orlando Storm—will begin their inaugural campaigns'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly name the exact three new teams.
